notes:
Migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (2026-09-12, continuation of the fin/1-33 rollout). Real oracle text (Scryfall-verified, fin/34): 'Lifelink / {2}, {T}: Target opponent gains control of another target permanent you control. If they do, you draw a card.' {W}, Legendary Creature — Moogle, 1/2 (added `pt:[1,2]` — missing before this migration). New standing rule applied: Lifelink is a bare printed keyword here (self-only, no grant/broadcast, no downstream trigger reading lifegain on this card) — gets NO fact, unlike adelbert-steiner's own earlier (2026-09-11) `lifegain` fact for its own bare Lifelink; the old `lifelink-gain` fact and its 3 real 'life gain' outbound matches (Aerith Gainsborough, Excalibur II, Minwu, White Mage) are removed per this explicit instruction, not an oversight. Two baseline facts (self-cast, self-enters, typeLine-anchored 'Legendary Creature') added, matching this rollout's convention; the OLD `self-graveyard` baseline (a bare presence-shaped zone fact with no real death mechanic behind it) is dropped entirely, matching delivery-moogle's own precedent that a creature with no death trigger/consequence gets no baseline dies/graveyard fact at all.

Real ability facts: (1) `{event:'tap', subject:'self', target:'self'}` for the `{T}` self-tap cost component (Coeurl/fin-12's own established exemption shape — the cost payment itself is never logged, `isSelfTapActivationCostFact`). (2) `{event:'gainControl', controller:'you', recipient:'opp', targeted:true}` for 'Target opponent gains control of another target permanent you control' — `gainControl` was PARKED vocabulary (verify-synergy.mjs's `PARKED_ACTION_FNS`) despite the underlying `Actions.gainControl`/`RealPlayer.gainControl` already being real, wired, and exercised (stolen-uniform, unexpected-request, zidane-tantalus-thief); promoted it to real fact vocabulary as part of this task (`producedEvents`'s new `case 'gainControl'`, hardcoded `side:'you'` — the real trace's own `entry.controller` names the RECIPIENT ('opp0'), not the doer, same reasoning `cast`/`playLand` already use for their own hardcoded 'you'). `controller:'you'` (the doer/activator) + `recipient:'opp'` (who ends up with control) follow the established doer-vs-recipient split (`Fact.recipient`'s own doc comment, introduced for Bahamut's damage fact). No `target` Constraints written (the real effect has no type filter — 'another target permanent,' not 'another target creature' — so an unconstrained event fact is the honest shape; self-exclusion ('another') has no vocabulary and isn't needed on a SOURCE event fact the way it would be on a `subject`, since this fact's `subject` is correctly omitted — the permanent that changes control varies and isn't 'self', same 'omitted subject resolves to unknown' convention Gaius van Baelsar's own forced-sacrifice fact established). (3) `{event:'drawCard', controller:'you'}` for 'If they do, you draw a card' — modeled as a separate, independent real fact (not encoding the 'if they do' conditional link itself as data), per this task's own explicit instruction; this engine already has this vocabulary (drawCard promoted 2026-09-05). Sink: `{to:'Battlefield', controller:'you'}` (unconstrained — wants any permanent you control, i.e. fodder to give away), same shape the old pre-migration sink had, just `zone`->`to`.

Every fact `value:-1` per the standing 'Fact.value accuracy deliberately deprioritized' rule (SYNERGY_DESIGN.md). All 6 facts annotated via `annotations-authoring.json` + `compute-annotations.mjs` (2 typeLine-anchored 'Legendary Creature', 4 oracle-anchored against the real {2},{T} ability line); added to `scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs`'s `ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS`.

Scenarios: consolidated to ONE real engine-piloted scenario (dropped the old flat harness.ts Scenario[] style entirely, including its `keywordScenarios(...)` spread — Lifelink/legend-rule demonstrations no longer back any declared fact once Lifelink itself has none, and the new standing 'default to 1 scenario' rule applies), per this task's own explicit instruction: cast (real {W} mana payment, 4 real Plains seeded via `basicLandsFor('{3}{W}')`) -> real turn passage (clears summoning sickness) -> real {2},{T} activation -> the real custom effect picks another real permanent already on the battlefield (one of the same 4 real Plains — no synthetic/placeholder filler) -> real `gainControl` (opponent) -> real `drawCard` (you). `chooseTarget`'s own documented 'always the first pool candidate' behavior picks the first Plains still in `getCardsIn('Battlefield')` after Stiltzkin excludes itself.

Real, LIVE cross-session collision hit and worked around during this task, flagged prominently: `functional-model/scripts/verify-synergy.mjs` and `scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs` were being actively, repeatedly rewritten wholesale by a concurrent peer session (visibly landing unrelated real work — Phoenix Down/fin-29 exile-event promotion, sidequest-catch-a-fish-cooking-campsite, magitek-infantry, summon-primal-garuda, etc. — across several distinct snapshots within minutes) while this task was in progress; an earlier stash (`git stash list` showed one entry, 'WIP on main: 970e163...', reflog shows repeated 'reset: moving to HEAD' events) briefly reverted BOTH files all the way past even the pre-today baseline (no `pump`/`tap`/`animate` promotions, no `isSelfTapActivationCostFact`) before the peer's own further commits/writes brought them back past where they'd been. This card's own two small, targeted additions (the `gainControl` promotion in `producedEvents` + its `PARKED_ACTION_FNS`/`explainableFns` bookkeeping; the `isSelfTapActivationCostFact` exemption + its call site; this slug's own entry in `ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS`) were each re-applied after being wiped mid-task and are confirmed landed and stable as of the final verification run below — but given the file's own observed volatility, re-check `verify-synergy.mjs`/`annotation-coverage.mjs` for `gainControl`/`isSelfTapActivationCostFact`/`stiltzkin-moogle-merchant` if this card's own verify-synergy run ever regresses unexpectedly; this is a real, generalizable cross-session hazard (two sessions editing the same shared engine scripts at once), not a one-off, and is worth the orchestrator's attention independent of this card.

`npx vite-node functional-model/scripts/verify-synergy.mjs stiltzkin-moogle-merchant`: 0 hard failures (3 expected `tapForMana`-unrecognized-action soft notes, same class every engine-piloted casting/activation scenario gets). Full pool (315 v2 cards, snapshot taken concurrently with the peer's own in-flight work): 14 with hard failures — none attributable to this card; one pre-existing soft note now surfaced pool-wide by the `gainControl` promotion (zidane-tantalus-thief's own real, previously-invisible `fn:'gainControl'` action with no matching declared produce — a genuine, pre-existing authoring gap on a DIFFERENT card, same 'note, not fail' treatment every previous promotion (`pump`, `tap`, `animate`) already caused pool-wide; not fixed here, out of scope). `npx vitest run functional-model`: 237/238 (1 failure is `magitek-infantry`'s own in-flight, not-yet-fully-annotated facts — a concurrent peer card, not this task's own regression; this card's own facts are fully annotated and contribute 0 failures). Real `find-synergies.mjs` diff (isolated: reverted just this card's own `synergy.json` to git HEAD, re-ran the full pool, diffed lines mentioning 'Stiltzkin', restored): 241 -> 351 lines (net +110). LOST (24, all expected/intentional): 21 old 'graveyard presence' outbound lines (the removed baseline self-graveyard fact) + 3 old 'life gain' outbound lines (the removed Lifelink fact, per today's standing rule). GAINED (134): overwhelmingly the new baseline `self-enters` fact's real 'enters the battlefield'/'moves to battlefield (from X)' inbound matches (pure gain — this card had zero battlefield-presence matching before), plus one new self-interaction tag ('second-copy-legendary'). Zero new matches from the new `gainControl`/`drawCard` facts themselves (confirmed: no pool card currently declares a sink wanting `event:'gainControl'` or `event:'drawCard'`) — expected, same 'promotes vocabulary for a future payoff card, doesn't itself create a match today' pattern `pump`'s own promotion already established.
knownGaps: gainControl/drawCard facts create zero real interaction matches today (no pool card wants either event yet) — real, vocabulary-only promotion, not a modeling gap on this card.

The `{2},{T}` self-tap activation-cost fact has no achievable trace evidence by construction (engine.ts pays a {T} cost via a bare state.tap call, never logged) — exempted via the established isSelfTapActivationCostFact pattern (Coeurl/fin-12 precedent), not a gap unique to this card.

Cross-session hazard: functional-model/scripts/verify-synergy.mjs and scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs were being actively rewritten by a concurrent peer session during this task (see notes above) — this card's own additions to both files are confirmed landed as of the final verification run, but the underlying two-sessions-editing-the-same-shared-file risk is real and not specific to this card; flagged to engine notes.md for the orchestrator.
